travel-cog v1.0.6 Changelog

- SKILL.md rewritten and significantly condensed for clarity and brevity.
- Description shortened, with marketing copy and detailed feature lists removed.
- Output formats now summarized (PDF, HTML dashboards).
- Practical usage and code examples retained.
- Feature highlights reorganized into concise, bulleted sections.
- Reference to related skills added.

- Added example Python code for integrating with OpenClaw agents (fire-and-forget), including usage of notify_session_key for long-running tasks.
- Clarified agent usage, specifying differences between OpenClaw agents (async/notify) and all other agents (blocking).
- Removed SDK file handling and timeout details from skill documentation, pointing instead to the main cellcog skill for those topics.
- No changes to travel planning features or outputs.

- Updated the SDK usage section to feature a simpler "Quick start" code example.
- Clarified reference to the cellcog skill for API details, delivery modes, and advanced options.
- Removed deprecated session notification parameters from setup instructions.
- Improved instructions for finding comprehensive SDK documentation.
- No functional changes; documentation improvements only.

- Updated DeepResearch Bench ranking date from February 2026 to April 2026 in the description and main documentation.
- No functional or feature changes; documentation only.

- Updated the SKILL.md description for clarity and conciseness.
- Added supported operating systems (darwin, linux, windows) to metadata.
- Added a homepage URL to metadata.
- Improved formatting and organization of documentation.
- No changes to functionality—documentation update only.

- Clarified that PDF is the default output format when no format is specified.
- No changes to code or core features. This update refines documentation for greater clarity.

- Initial release of travel-cog, a travel research and planning skill powered by CellCog.
- Generates custom trip itineraries and deep travel research (current prices, visa, weather, local events, hidden gems).
- Outputs in PDF, interactive HTML, or Markdown formats based on user preference.
- Supports detailed travel logistics, local recommendations, and practical guides.
- Requires the cellcog skill as a dependency for setup and API access.
